budget_total_adopted_note: Citywide Expenditure Summary, FY2026 Budget column: $7,050 million total expenditure across all City funds (General, Special, Enterprise, with interfund eliminations). Published rounded to millions; excludes Service Chargeback and Internal Service Funds; it is an expenditure-based total (not a total-appropriation figure including fund-balance application).
gf_adopted_basis: General Fund Summary (book section II-3): Total Expenditures and Other Uses FY2026 = $3,047,770,272 (= $2,539,770,524 expenditures other than debt/PAYGO + $507,999,748 debt service and PAYGO capital projects). Total GF budget including fund-balance application = $3,352,720,551.

source_files.note: Mayor's letter: PROPOSED all-funds $7.0B, PROPOSED GF $3.03B

honest_gaps: No exact-dollar all-funds adopted total is published: the Citywide Expenditure Summary is rounded to $ millions ($7,050M) and excludes Service Chargeback and Internal Service Funds, so the 7050000000 figure is a rounded, expenditure-scoped adopted total, not a total-appropriations figure.

The widely-quoted $7.5B/$7.0B figures trace to the Mayor's PROPOSED budget (letter, book page I-x); the adopted figures extracted here come from the adopted book's FY2026 Budget columns (council action June 2025).
Adoption amendments between proposed and adopted are not itemized in a single table; GF adopted ($3,047.8M) vs GF proposed ($3.03B per letter) differ modestly.
Component volumes II_GFEC/II_GFR (General Fund expenditures/revenues) were fetched but not fully parsed; totals were taken from the General Fund Summary instead.
extraction_notes: houstontx.gov is plain-curl accessible (unlike okc.gov). Downloaded 8 PDFs from the FY2026 adopted budget hub. Combined book parsed with PyMuPDF; GF summary columns rebuilt from word coordinates (raw text stream interleaves columns). Extracted 2026-11-22 UTC.
